added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite (revision 058515877, 11 failure ids) and after_suite (revision 33dc7ff50, 4 failure ids) arms in its manifest; all four head failures are present in the base set, so the added delta is empty. The matched-population logs final-base-spa.log and final-spa.log confirm 11 failed/32 passed and 4 failed/39 passed over the same 43 collected tests.
call_sites: docs/ui/state-loader.js:544 revalidateProjectState home-route short-circuit (called at docs/ui/shell.jsx:155)

findings.text: follow-on: loaded is Boolean(fleetIndex), and docs/ui/shell.jsx:230 sets fleetIndex only on a successful array response, so a 404 or network failure at /_projects/index.json leaves the home on "Loading fleet summary…" indefinitely where the previous render fell back to mounted-project counts; the done-when mandates never showing a zero so this is spec-compliant, but a permanently pending home on a failed summary is a UX defect worth recording.

follow-on: a project whose summary row omits plans_count renders neither as a row (Number(null) > 0 is false at :17) nor as dormant (:22 now requires plans_count === 0), while the eyebrow at :97 still counts it in projects.length, so the header can claim more projects shown than the home renders for a mounted project the summary does not carry.

follow-on: .filter(item => item.plan) silently drops any schedule bar whose slug is absent from window.STATE.inventory, so a bar referencing an unloaded or cross-project plan disappears with no signal where it previously rendered from its embedded row; the drop is defensible for a stale inventory but leaves a degraded flow with nothing marking the omission.

item_verdicts.call_sites: docs/ui/shell.jsx:490 renders FleetHome (the changed component), docs/ui/shell.jsx:226-238 is refreshFleetIndex with the reckon-fleet listener, docs/ui/state-loader.js:544 is the home-route short-circuit in revalidateProjectState called at docs/ui/shell.jsx:155; docs/ui/crew.jsx:363 renders the changed DerivedFlow.
item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 058515877; 33dc7ff50 changes the home, shell, crew and state-loader plus four updated tests and one new test file, and 733b71f4c adds the 52-line evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks that the home show a loading state and never a zero until the summary arrives, that /_discover be fetched only on palette open, that a browser test assert both, and that browser cases run rather than skip; tests/test_spa_home_view_loads_a_summary.py:116-135 asserts both, both cases ran (final-spa.log, 313s, no skips) and the negative control reddens the discovery assertion.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to render the home view from the fleet summary alone, fetch full inventories only when the command palette first opens, and resolve schedule bars by slug; docs/ui/home.jsx:94-124 does the first, docs/ui/shell.jsx:240 gates discovery on cmdKOpen, and docs/ui/crew.jsx:46-49 resolves the slug.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete, two commits (33dc7ff50, 733b71f4c), a matched base/head gate (11 failed/32 passed vs 4 failed/39 passed), a loader-regression arm of 19 passed EXIT=0, and the negative control at negative-control-complete.log reading 2 failed EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is docs/ui/{home,shell,shell-palette,crew}.jsx, docs/ui/state-loader.js, eight tests/ files and the fragment; git diff --stat 058515877..733b71f4c touches ten of those paths and every one is declared, with none outside the fence drafted.

justifications.durability: tests/test_spa_home_view_loads_a_summary.py:118 asserts no /_discover before the palette and :124 exactly one afterward against the recorded fetch log, and negative-control-complete.log shows those assertions redden (EXIT=1) when the declared per-project home fetch is restored, so the guard fails on the regression it was added for; the stale-response race at :112-115 is guarded by the request counter in docs/ui/shell.jsx:228.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records a matched-population gate over the same nine files at base 058515877 (11 failed, 32 passed, EXIT=1) and head 33dc7ff50 (4 failed, 39 passed, EXIT=1) with the four head failures a subset of the base ones, so added_failure_count is 0, and the negative control at negative-control-complete.log reads 2 failed EXIT=1, but the two new tests rest on the worker's recorded run rather than any independent re-run here.
justifications.fit: docs/ui/home.jsx:22 swaps Number(project.plans_count) === 0 for project.plans_count === 0 to keep a null count out of the dormant set, follows the surrounding filter idiom, removes the now-dead homeJustLanded/HOME_LANDED_WINDOW_MS cleanly, and introduces no plan label, version or author in any name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/ui/home.jsx:94 renders a loading state until the summary arrives and :99/104/124 paint counts, progress and activity from the summary fields alone, docs/ui/shell.jsx:240 fetches /_discover only when cmdKOpen, and docs/ui/crew.jsx:46-49 resolves each bar's slug against the inventory, so all four clauses of the goal land.
justifications.reuse: docs/ui/crew.jsx:46 inlines a slug-keyed inventory Map, the same idiom already used at docs/ui/sprint.jsx:77,115,167, and docs/ui/state-loader.js:228 follows that module's own request-counter pattern; a capability search over docs/ui found no shared owner of a slug-to-row resolver to extend, and the change forks none.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --stat 058515877..733b71f4c touches only docs/ui/{home,shell,crew}.jsx, docs/ui/state-loader.js, five tests/ files and the declared evidence fragment, all inside the manifest's declared write paths, with nothing drafted outside them.
